BETA Close X Ninety One PLC has announced the repurchase of 7,000,000 ordinary shares between July 27, 2026, and July 31, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The purchases were executed through J.P. Morgan Securities plc, with prices ranging from 209.0000 GBp to 215.0000 GBp per share. The company intends to cancel these repurchased shares, and following these transactions, Ninety One PLC holds no shares in treasury, with 661,687,743 ordinary shares currently in issue.
